rounds.ai_message: Hello, this is Daniel from Sunline Seamless. You inquired about seamless leggings yesterday. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好,我是 Sunline 无缝的 Daniel。你昨天咨询无缝打底裤,请问有什么可以帮您?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍,说明来意:需要无缝产品
rounds.common_mistakes: seamless 形容词,常做定语 seamless knitting / seamless garment。
rounds.tips_zh: 联系无缝厂时要先报:产品类型(内衣/打底裤/上衣)、目标客群、尺码范围。
rounds.user_response_example: Hello Daniel, this is Chen Wei from Lily Garments. I am looking for seamless leggings for our activewear line.

rounds.ai_message: Activewear seamless — good. We do leggings, bras, tops, and bodysuits. What composition are you looking for? Nylon-spandex is our standard, but we also do polyester-spandex.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 运动无缝 — 好的。我们做打底裤、运动内衣、上衣、连体衣。成分呢?锦纶氨纶是标准,也能做涤纶氨纶。
rounds.common_mistakes: nylon(锦纶) 和 polyester(涤纶) 在无缝产品里都常用,nylon 手感细腻、polyester 排汗好。
rounds.tips_zh: 锦纶/氨纶(nylon/spandex) 手感细腻,适合中高端;涤纶/氨纶(poly/spandex) 排汗好,适合运动款。
rounds.user_response_example: Nylon-spandex. What's the typical ratio, and what denier do you use?

rounds.ai_message: We typically run 80% nylon, 20% spandex for activewear. The nylon is 40 denier, spandex is 20 denier. About the gauge — our machines are E28. Does that match your target?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 运动款我们常用 80% 锦纶、20% 氨纶。锦纶 40 旦,氨纶 20 旦。机号方面,我们是 E28。跟你目标对得上吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: machine gauge(机号) 是每英寸针数,E28 表示每英寸 28 针,数字越大布越细。
rounds.tips_zh: E28 是中细针,适合 leggings / 上衣;E14 是粗针,适合冬季厚款。
rounds.user_response_example: E28 is what we want for this style. So 40D nylon + 20D spandex, 80/20 ratio, on E28 machines.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed. Now about the construction — for leggings, we can do a tube with a shaped waistband, gusset at the crotch, and varying GSM for compression. Do you want body shaping zones, or uniform GSM?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 确认。打底裤可以做成筒形,加成形腰头、三角区,不同部位不同克重做压力。要做分区塑形,还是整布均匀克重?
rounds.common_mistakes: gusset(三角区/菱形插片) 是无缝打底裤关键结构,加弹性、减少摩擦。
rounds.tips_zh: 无缝打底裤的核心结构:腰头编织、gusset 三角区、腿部不同分区压力。
rounds.user_response_example: We want body shaping — higher compression at the waist, lighter at the thigh, medium at the calf. The buyer is targeting a sculpting fit.

rounds.ai_message: Body shaping is our strength. We do knit programs in 3 to 4 zones — waist, hip, thigh, calf — each with its own stitch length and tension to control compression. The buyer will see the difference on the body.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 分区塑形是我们的强项。我们做 3-4 个分区 — 腰、臀、大腿、小腿,每个分区独立线圈长度和压力。上身效果客户能看出来。
rounds.common_mistakes: seamless 的分区是机器编程实现,不同区用不同 stitch length(线圈长度)。
rounds.tips_zh: 分区塑形 = 不同线圈长度 + 不同张力,实现差异化压力。
rounds.user_response_example: 4 zones is good. What's the typical GSM range? For example, waist vs. thigh?

rounds.ai_message: Waist at 280 GSM for high compression, hip at 240, thigh at 200, calf at 180. The leg opening can taper down to 160 for a clean finish. The buyer might want a smoother gradient — we can fine-tune in the sample.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 腰部 280 克高压力,臀部 240,大腿 200,小腿 180,脚口可以收到 160 做收口。客户如果想要更平滑的过渡,打样时细调。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 讨论克重分布,准备打样
rounds.common_mistakes: taper down(收口) 是无缝机器自然实现的,不需要缝合,工艺优势。
rounds.tips_zh: 分区克重差异越大,塑形感越强;客户首次尝试建议从温和分区开始。
rounds.user_response_example: That GSM range sounds right. Please send a proto sample in size M so we can check the fit and the compression.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. Proto sample in size M, ready in 10 days. About the size set — what sizes do you need? S, M, L, or full size run XS to XL?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。M 码产前样,10 天出。尺码方面 — S/M/L,还是 XS 到 XL 全尺码?
rounds.common_mistakes: size run(尺码组) 行业里也说 size set,口语里直接说 size run。
rounds.tips_zh: 无缝产品全尺码打样成本高,通常先打中码确认 fit,再扩尺码。
rounds.user_response_example: First, just M and L. Once we approve the fit, we'll do the full size run XS to XL.

rounds.ai_message: Smart. M and L first, then full run after fit approval. Let me summarize: 80/20 nylon-spandex, 40D/20D, E28, body-shaping 4 zones (280/240/200/180 GSM), leg opening 160, gusset, sample in 10 days, lead time 35 days after fit approval. PI by tomorrow. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 聪明。先 M、L,fit 批准后做全尺码。总结:80/20 锦纶氨纶,40D/20D,E28,4 区塑形(280/240/200/180 克),脚口 160,三角区,10 天出样,fit 批准后 35 天出货。PI 明天发。还有别的吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: fit approval(fit 批准) 是打样尺寸定型,批准后才进大货。
rounds.tips_zh: fit approval 包括上身试穿、压力测试、版型签字。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the PI to chen.wei@lilygarments.com. Looking forward to the proto sample. Thanks, Daniel.
